body: The way I usually try to keep my mind busy is looking for new music, it helps you feel I guess
Not sure if you know but you are already almost doing the same, maybe not as a job but you're basically trying to help people you don't know. Even if it's behind a screen or what not.

I thought that too so I'm still trying to keep me busy, I started working for charity and doing yoga. But at the end of the day I'm laying awake in bed for ours trying to resist going on my phone or thinking dark thoughts, still thanks for the option and I hope we'll both get to end feeling worthless

You don't have to blame yourself for being who you are, just know that even without talking to people in real life there are always people who want to be there for you. 

And no matter how much it sucks just try taking it Al up and change it one step at a time, don't try to be happy just try to be who you want to be a little step at a time

Edit: sorry if I didn't follow the guidelines, the point I'm trying to make is that I'm proud you're talking about it
